It adds a `commitlint` job to `ci.yml` (pull requests only) that runs `npx --no -- commitlint --from $BASE_SHA --to $HEAD_SHA --verbose` with the existing `commitlint.config.js`. It also adds the matching row in CONTRIBUTING and the line in AGENTS.md, and removes `@commitlint/cli` from knip's `ignoreDependencies`
